export const meta = {
  name: 'hail-b2-round7',
  description: 'B2 round seven: D35, flood watches (FA.A, zone products) return to the zone list; only flood warnings (FL.W, polygons) stay out; the words name the ten products and keep the NCEI-only distinction (IEM reports of tornado, flood and flash flood are joined); joins and docs fixers, then a short re-check',
  phases: [{ title: 'Fix', detail: 'joins list restore, rows, tests, rebuild; docs and About' }, { title: 'Recheck', detail: 'tests, store verify, grep, smoke' }],
}
const WT = '/home/user/wt/wt-b2'
const BRIEF = '/home/user/wt/briefs/hail-b2-brief.md'
const OUT = '/home/user/hail-b2/out2'
const STORE_DIR = '/home/user/hail-b1/out2/store/store'
const VENV = '/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python'
const COMMON = `You work in the git worktree ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b2, at the safety commit of round 6). Read the last two sections of ${BRIEF} ("Supervisor decision after the flood products research (D34)" and "Supervisor correction (D35) and the round-7 list") first; D35 corrects D34 and is your task list. Repository rules (AGENTS.md is in your context): Python first, evidence honesty, feed contracts changed with the parser and the tests together, plain wording in sentence case, no em-dashes, no model, AI-vendor or AI-product names, tests with every behaviour change. The other fixer edits other files in this worktree now: edit only the files you own, never run git checkout, stash, reset, add, commit or push, never reformat a file you do not own, never delete anything outside a folder you created under ${OUT}/<your-name>/. A python with pyarrow and numpy is ${VENV}; the B1 store is ${STORE_DIR}; the joins cache is /home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache. Return a plain report: what you changed (file and line), the commands you ran with their tails, and anything not done.`
const JOINS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the joins fixer; you own website/joins.py, tests/test_joins.py and, for this run only, the CONTRACTS rows ncei_storm_events and nws_zone_products in website/sources.py. Apply D35: FA.A returns to ZONE_PRODUCTS (ten products: HW.W, WS.W, BZ.W, IS.W, EC.W, WC.W, FW.W, DS.W, WI.Y, FA.A) with PRODUCT_NAMES "Flood watch"; FL.W stays out; the D34 comment block now says that flood warnings (FL.W) are polygon products and that the 18 county-only flood watch events go to B5's county path, while zone-coded flood watches are joined; the module docstring and WORDS_JOINS sentences follow (the records sentence keeps the NCEI-only wording: NCEI county-coded points of tornado, flood, flash flood, heavy rain, funnel cloud, lightning and debris flow are not joined in this version; the IEM reports of those kinds are joined as reports); the nws_zone_products row lists the ten products and says FL.W is a polygon product not joined in this version and county-only flood watches are not joined; the _zone_events docstring counts are recounted on the restored list; tests updated to the ten (the D34_ZONE_PRODUCTS constant, ZoneProductListTests, the offline build test's request set); run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_joins (tail). Then rebuild: copy ${STORE_DIR} to ${OUT}/joins/store-r7, python -m website.joins build --store ${OUT}/joins/store-r7 --cache /home/user/hail-b2/out/joins/cache --procs 4, verify, compare (15 of 15 delta 0), tar as ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz after verify passes (keep the round-6 tar as hail-store.tar.gz.r6); report the index counts (public zone events expected 4,960; z/ bytes about 919,402; unplaced 452; midnight CAN rows 447) and run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_joins tests.test_site tests.test_hail (tail). Write the counts you measured into ${OUT}/joins/r7-counts.json for the docs owner.`
const DOCS = `${COMMON}\n\nYou are the docs fixer; you own docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/DESIGN.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, website/templates/about.html and research/hail-history/validation-evidence/b2-verification.json. Apply D35 everywhere round 6 wrote the nine-product list or the removal of flood watches: the ten products named with "flood watch" among the joined zone products; flood warnings (FL.W polygons) and the 18 county-only flood watches in the B5 hand-off; the "not joined" sentences made explicit as NCEI county-coded records (the IEM reports of tornado, flood, flash flood, funnel cloud, lightning and debris flow are joined as reports: the store holds LSR tornado 10, flood 115, flash flood 68, funnel cloud 45, lightning 6 and debris flow 15 report points per the round-6 checker); the wording "once the D34 change and its rebuild are in" removed in favour of the measured state; the figures restored to the round-7 counts (read ${OUT}/joins/r7-counts.json when it appears, polling every 2 minutes up to 40 minutes; expected 4,960 public zone events, z/ about 919,402 B, 452 unplaced, 447 midnight CAN rows, 3,411 public and 276 fire cancellation-only groups with 446 at 00:00 UTC and 2,965 at other times); the About paragraph's kinds sentence (lines about 45 to 66) lists the ten products and keeps the nine phrases tests/test_site.py HailJoins asserts; the verification record's notes carry round 7 and D35 with the restored figures; open items renumbered consistently. Em-dashes 0; sentence case; no model or AI-vendor names. Report the diff stat and quote the corrected sentences.`
phase('Fix')
const fixes = await parallel([
  () => agent(JOINS, { label: 'fix7:joins', phase: 'Fix', model: WORKER }),
  () => agent(DOCS, { label: 'fix7:docs', phase: 'Fix', model: WORKER }),
])
phase('Recheck')
const recheck = await agent(`Read-only checker in ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b2). Read the D34 and D35 sections of ${BRIEF}. Never edit, stage, commit or push; scratch only under ${OUT}/recheck7/ which you create. Run and quote: ${VENV} -m unittest discover -s tests (tail; all must pass); python desktop/launcher.py --selftest payload; python -m website.joins verify and compare on ${OUT}/joins/store-r7; the index counts (public zone events 4,960 expected; FA.A events present; FL.W absent); grep -n "FL.W\\|FA.A\\|flood watch\\|flood warning\\|nine\\|ten" website/joins.py website/sources.py docs/DECISIONS.md docs/DESIGN.md website/templates/about.html research/hail-history/validation-evidence/b2-verification.json and judge every hit against D35 (quote any sentence that still says flood watches are not joined, lists nine products, or implies IEM tornado or flood reports are absent); a --hail-history --sample --hail-store ${OUT}/joins/hail-store.tar.gz build into ${OUT}/recheck7/real with PW_CHROMIUM=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium ${VENV} tools/smoke_map.py and tools/smoke_pages.py on it (tails); the flag-off identity against 7aec754 (git archive into ${OUT}/recheck7/base-src, build --sample --now 2026-10-18T12:00:00Z both, diff -rq: only map.js, map.css and ?v= lines may differ); git -C ${WT} status --short and diff --stat 7aec754; em-dash and banned-name counts over added lines. Return a short JSON: tests, selftest, verify, compare, counts, smoke_map, smoke_pages, identity, the grep judgement, and every check that failed.`, { label: 'recheck7', phase: 'Recheck', model: WORKER })
return { fixes: fixes.map((f) => (f || '').slice(0, 5000)), recheck }
